```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(here)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(tidybayes)
library(brms)
library(tidyverse)
library(c14bazAAR)

library(survival)
library(survminer)
```

```{r}
dir = here::here()

#Imnport data
df <- read_csv(paste0(dir,"/data/SARD_Mar2021_14C.csv")) |>
  mutate(Species = factor(Species)) |>
  filter(Species != "Homo sapiens" | is.na(Species),
         Date > 75)
```

```{r}
df_sub <- df |>
  select(Site, Date, Uncertainty, `Lab ID`, `Archaeological Sub-chronology`,
         Biome) |>
  rename(Technology = `Archaeological Sub-chronology`) |>
  mutate(c14age = as.numeric(Date),
         c14std = as.numeric(Uncertainty)) |>
  as.c14_date_list() |>
  calibrate(choices = "calprobdistr") |>
  tidyr::unnest(cols = c("calprobdistr"))

df_sub_int <- df_sub |>
  group_by(Site, `Lab ID`, Technology, Biome) |>
  summarize(upr = quantile(calage, 0.975),
            lwr = quantile(calage, 0.025)) |>
  filter(!is.na(Technology))


```

```{r}
df_sub_order <- df_sub_int |>
  arrange(lwr) |>
  group_by(Site, 'Lab ID', Technology, Biome) |>
  mutate(g = cumsum(c(TRUE, lwr[-1] > head(cummax(upr), -1)))) |>
  group_by(g, Site, 'Lab ID', Technology, Biome) |>
  mutate(max_upr = max(upr),
         min_lwr = min(lwr)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(Site, 'Lab ID', Technology, max_upr, min_lwr, Biome) |>
  distinct() |>
  mutate(Event = 1,
         Occupation = seq(1,n(),1),
         Duration = max_upr-min_lwr,
         
         Technology = if_else(
           str_detect(Technology, 'Iron'),
           'Ceramic LSA',
           Technology
           ))


period <- tibble(
  Technology = as.factor(c('Ceramic LSA', 'Final LSA', 'Wilton', 
                       'Oakhurst', 'Robberg')),
  period_start = as.numeric(c(1457, 3898, 7784, 12789, 19923)),
  period_end = as.numeric(c(97, 1318, 4636, 8705, 13145))
)

df_sub_order <- df_sub_order |>
  left_join(period, by = 'Technology') |>
  mutate(period_duration = period_start - period_end,
         
         # Time from period beginning to first observed occupation
         entry = pmax(0,period_start - max_upr),
         # Time from period beginning to last observed occupation
         exit_raw = period_start - min_lwr,
         # Don't allow exit beyond the end of the period
         exit = pmin(exit_raw,period_duration),
         # Event occurs if termination is observed before period end
         event = if_else((exit_raw > 0) & 
                         (exit_raw < period_duration), 1L, 0L)) |>
  
  filter(!is.na(Technology))
```

```{r}
fit <- survfit(
  Surv(entry, exit, event) ~ Technology + Biome,
  data = df_sub_order |> filter(Technology == 'Oakhurst')
)

surv_plot <- ggsurvplot(
  fit,
  conf.int = FALSE,
  risk.table = TRUE,
  xlab = "Time since beginning of Wilton period",
  ylab = "Survival probability"
)

print(surv_plot$plot)
```

# Bayesian Analysis

```{r}
wilton_df <- df_sub_order |>
  filter(Technology == "Wilton") |>
  mutate(
    censored = if_else(event == 1, "none", "right")
  )

fit_weibull_0 <- brm(
  exit | cens(censored) ~ 1,
  data = wilton_df,
  family = weibull(),
  chains = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  seed = 1,
  cores = parallel::detectCores()
)

summary(fit_weibull_0)
# shape is > 1, so abandonment hazard increases with occupation duration
```

```{r}
fit_weibull_tech <- brm(
  Duration | cens(censored) ~ Tech,
  data = df_hol_filt,
  family = weibull(),
  chains = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  seed = 1234,
  cores = parallel::detectCores()
)

summary(fit_weibull_tech)
```

```{r}
fit_weibull_env <- brm(
  Duration | cens(censored) ~
    Tech +
    RFZ,
  data = df_hol_filt,
  family = weibull(),
  chains = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  seed = 12345,
  cores = parallel::detectCores()
)

summary(fit_weibull_env)
```

## Test models

```{r}
fit_exponential <- brm(
  Duration | cens(censored) ~
    Tech +
    RFZ,
  data = df_hol_filt,
  family = exponential(),
  chains = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  seed = 123456,
  cores = parallel::detectCores()
)

summary(fit_exponential)
```

```{r}
loo_compare(
  loo(fit_weibull_env),
   loo(fit_exponential)
)
```

```{r}
with(
    df_hol_filt,
    table(Tech, RFZ)
)

#Low observations may make the model fit poorly
```

```{r}
hypothesis(fit_weibull_tech, 'shape > 1', class = "")
```

```{r}
draws <- as_draws_df(fit_weibull_tech)

industry_effect <- exp(draws$b_TechEarlyIronAge)

mean(industry_effect)
quantile(
  industry_effect,
  c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975)
)
```

## Model shape paramter as random

```{r}
fit_shape_tech <- brm(
  bf(Duration | cens(censored) ~ Tech,
     shape ~ Tech),
  data = df_hol_filt,
  family = weibull(),
  chains = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  cores = parallel::detectCores(),
  seed = 777
)

summary(fit_shape_tech)
```
